title: Store Update 1.38.0
body:
# Store Update 1.38.0

Howdy Raiders!

Store Update 1.38.0 is rolling out now across every platform. It adds two new color options for the Torpedo set, Camo and Black, and these will be added automatically for anyone who already owns the outfit. As with earlier updates, there is no need to restart the game to get them.

Today also marks the start of the Expedition Departure. Best of luck to those beginning a brand new run. If you're already partway through your Fourth Expedition, let us know which Mystery Rewards have come your way. If you'd like a refresher on how Expeditions work and what to expect from them, our most recent Expedition article covers that.

We've taken note of your feedback about matchmaking. Overall it performs well, but there's still room to make it better, particularly during periods of low player population, in certain regions, or under specific map conditions. We're actively working on improvements for these situations.

Beginning today, we're testing changes to the matchmaking algorithm designed to raise the overall quality of your matches. Keep in mind that finding a match may take a bit longer than before, since the system is now putting in extra effort to find you a stronger match.

In practice, this should mean more consistent pairings with squads that fit your playstyle and squad size, leading to raids that feel fairer and more enjoyable.

We'll continue monitoring our matchmaking data closely alongside your feedback. We plan to review these changes soon and share an update on how they're performing. Thank you for helping us improve matchmaking for the whole community.

For a deeper explanation of how the matchmaking system operates, our earlier deep-dive article has the full details.

See you Topside, //Raz
